key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:37B8
name: draw_blitter_line_segment
description: Computes the absolute deltas and the octant bits between two points, waits for the blitter to go idle, and programs the blitter line-mode control, modulo and size registers. It then writes one pixel word in memory, combined with a mask value when a flag is set.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:38D2
name: clip_line_to_region
description: Computes region codes for both segment endpoints and returns early when they share a region bit. Otherwise it stores the endpoints in globals and calls a clipping routine for each remaining segment.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3A24
name: stub_empty_return
description: Contains only a return with no loads, stores or calls, so it does no work. It is entered from two unnamed routines.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3A50
name: bisect_segment_midpoints
description: Repeatedly halves a segment by computing the midpoint of its coordinates, calls a test routine on each midpoint, and keeps the half that still matches until the endpoints converge. It returns early when a status flag is found.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3AE6
name: trace_polygon_outline_spans
description: Walks a byte-encoded polygon outline, scales each vertex by a stored factor and clamps the vertical position to 0 through 199. It records left and right boundary values for each scanline into a buffer, then calls the span routine for each recorded pair.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3C00
name: trace_polygon_outline_fill
description: Walks a byte-encoded polygon outline with the same scaling and vertical clamping as its sibling, recording boundary pairs for each scanline. It then calls the fill routine on every pair up to a terminator value and sets a flag when a span touches the last scanline.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3F7C
name: initialise_draw_request_record
description: Stores a value, a constant two, and two minus-one sentinels into a fixed-offset record, then stores pointer values and copies one word into four more fields. It finishes by waiting for the blitter to go idle.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3FBA
name: wait_blitter_idle
description: Spins on the DMA status register until the blitter busy bit clears, then returns. Five routines call it before touching blitter registers.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:3FCA
name: read_joystick_direction_state
description: Decodes the joystick port movement word into horizontal and vertical direction values of minus one, zero or one, and sets matching direction bits in a state word. It also copies the combined state into a second field and sets a button flag when the top bit of the raw port value is clear.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4068
name: copy_four_longs_to_globals
description: Calls a routine that returns a pointer, then copies the four consecutive 32-bit values at that pointer into four global variables.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4084
name: shift_small_index_left_four
description: Returns the input word unchanged when it is greater than three, and otherwise returns it shifted left by four bits. Six unnamed routines use it to turn a small index into a table offset.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:40B8
name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Contains only a return instruction, with no loads, stores or calls. Its single caller gets nothing from it.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:40EC
name: draw_clipped_sprite_columns
description: Reads a record from a table, rejects it when its horizontal position lies outside the screen width or its vertical span lies outside the screen height, and otherwise clips the top and bottom rows. It then calls one of several 16-byte row routines chosen by the low four bits of a parameter, once per column word, with a per-column mask check.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:42D0
name: mask_four_words_in_place
description: ANDs one mask value into four separate 16-bit memory locations, clearing the masked bits in each. It is entered by address rather than by a normal call.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:42DA
name: mask_three_words_return_byte
description: ANDs one mask value into three 16-bit memory locations and returns the input byte with a fixed bit pattern ORed into it. It is entered from one unnamed routine that uses the returned byte as a code.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4484
name: apply_plane_bit_mask
description: For each of up to four bitplane pointers in a table, either sets or clears the same bit in the word at that pointer, depending on the matching bit of a mask value. The table steps through the planes in order.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:45BC
name: allocate_memory_block
description: Calls the system memory allocator through the exec library base and returns its result. It returns minus one when the allocator gives back nothing.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:45DA
name: release_memory_block
description: Calls the system memory release routine through the exec library base and returns its result. It returns minus one when that result is zero.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:45FA
name: queue_wrapped_draw_requests
description: Fills one or more draw request records with fixed type and flag words and with positions taken from tables plus an offset. It wraps the vertical position when it runs past the 200-line screen height, and it writes each record in a loop until a status value is zero.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4716
name: queue_masked_draw_requests
description: Creates four draw request records in a loop, one per low bit of a mask value, each with a fixed type word and a value chosen by that bit. All four share the same position words.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:477C
name: install_copper_list_palette
description: Optionally swaps four stored long values, copies a 32-byte palette block for a selected index into the palette buffer, and waits for a raster line. It then writes colour and display pointer register pairs into a copper list ending in a wait marker, and restarts the copper.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4950
name: handle_keyboard_scancode
description: Decodes the keyboard serial byte by inverting and rotating it, then for a few key codes resets the display registers and clears game state. Other key codes start or end a timed wait for a handshake code, and one sets a flag word.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:49A4
name: reset_display_window_mode
description: Writes fixed display window, data fetch and bitplane control values, clears the scroll and state variables, and sets a flag. It returns with no result.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4A22
name: reset_display_window_blank_mode
description: Writes the same display window and data fetch values as its sibling routine, but sets the bitplane control to a blank mode. It then clears the scroll and state variables and sets a flag to zero.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4A46
name: clear_control_state_words
description: Clears four 16-bit state words in a control record and sets a flag to zero. It is called from two unnamed routines.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4A82
name: set_control_state_defaults
description: Clears two 16-bit state words, sets two others to forty, and sets a flag to one. It is called from two unnamed routines and reads no hardware.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4AF2
name: latch_keyboard_byte_state
description: Sets a flag to minus one, stores the low byte read through a pointer into a state word, and clears a second state word. The pointed-to byte is the serial keyboard input.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4B62
name: wait_for_raster_line
description: Spins reading the vertical position register until the beam reaches a fixed scanline, then returns the input value unchanged.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4B84
name: service_audio_channel_playback
description: When a stored level value has changed, reloads its data and resets the DMA enable bits. Otherwise, once a readiness flag is set, it loads the next sample pointer, length and period into one of four audio channel register sets and enables that channel's DMA bit, falling back to a stored pointer when the sample list ends.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4C50
name: select_active_resource_entry
description: When the first argument is zero it stores the second argument as a count, or leaves it unchanged. Otherwise it searches a resource record for an entry of one fixed type code, then stores that entry's data pointer and first word as the active item.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4CBC
name: open_cia_resource_and_cache
description: Copies up to fourteen 32-bit values from a record list into a global table, keeping only entries of one fixed type code. On its first run it opens the CIA-A resource through the exec library and stores the result, then returns a flag that is nonzero when the open failed.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4D4C
name: close_cached_resource_if_open
description: When a stored handle is nonzero, calls a library routine at a fixed offset with that handle and then clears the stored handle. It then calls a second routine before returning.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4D96
name: write_cia_control_pair
description: Writes a fixed byte with its top bit set to a CIA-A register, then writes a stored byte to the same register. It has no return value.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4D9E
name: write_cia_timer_value_byte
description: Writes a stored byte to a CIA timer register, then writes it again. It has no return value.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4DB6
name: clear_resource_slot_fields
description: Walks fifteen table entries and, for each non-null pointer, clears the 32-bit value stored eight bytes into the record it points to.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4DCE
name: silence_audio_channels
description: Zeroes the volume register of each of the four audio channels and clears two sound state words.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4DF2
name: silence_audio_and_set_mask
description: Zeroes the volume register of each of the four audio channels and sets a sound state word to fifteen. It is called from three unnamed routines.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4E10
name: call_routine_return_zero
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns zero. Its address is stored in the data of the program rather than called directly.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4E18
name: advance_audio_tick_counter
description: Increments a tick counter, and when it reaches six it resets the counter and runs a follow-up routine. On the other ticks it runs a per-channel routine for each of the four audio channel register blocks.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4E3C
name: call_routine_per_audio_channel
description: Calls a per-channel routine for each of the four audio channel register blocks, from the highest index down to zero.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4E70
name: step_audio_envelope_channel
description: Advances one audio channel's level by its step and clamps the result to a target. When the step is zero it reads the next entry of a sound sequence, sets the step and target from its fields, and either calls a handler from a jump table or looks up a second value in a table.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4E92
name: advance_audio_level_step
description: Adds the step value to a channel level, clamps the result so it does not fall below a stored floor, and writes it to the channel's volume field.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4EA6
name: load_audio_note_entry
description: Reads the effect code of a sound sequence entry. Code one calls a handler from a jump table, codes seven and eight set the sign of the step, and the step and target are then stored from the entry, with a second value looked up in a table.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4EC4
name: load_note_step_and_lookup
description: Stores a zero, then copies a value from a sound entry, a low nibble of a field as the step, and a second value looked up in a table keyed by the entry's first value. It is called from two unnamed routines.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4EFE
name: copy_word_with_signed_offset
description: Computes a signed word offset from an input value, with the sign chosen by a flag, and copies the word at that offset from a source address into a destination derived from another register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F10
name: store_word_at_record_offset
description: Stores the input word at a fixed offset inside the record pointed to by an address register.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F16
name: load_signed_audio_note_entry
description: Takes the step sign from a register parameter, then fills the channel step and target from a sound entry and looks up a second value in a table. It has the same record layout as its neighbours.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F1A
name: dispatch_channel_handler_by_state
description: Calls a handler selected from a jump table by a state value minus one, with each table entry four bytes apart. It is entered from three unnamed routines.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F52
name: lookup_table_entry_by_key
description: Searches a short table for the value stored at a record offset, then copies the element at an index given by a register into another field of the record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F6C
name: lookup_entry_by_high_nibble
description: Searches a short table for the key stored in a record, then copies the element selected by the high four bits of a byte field of the same record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F76
name: lookup_entry_by_low_nibble
description: Searches a short table for the key stored in a record, then copies the element selected by the low four bits of a byte field of the same record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F82
name: copy_record_word_to_slot
description: Copies one 16-bit word from a fixed offset in one record into a fixed offset in another record. It is entered by pointer from the data of the program.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:4F8C
name: commit_audio_channel_pointers
description: Calls a per-channel routine for each of four channels, then loads the sample pointer and length of each active channel into its audio registers. It advances a playback position by sixteen and wraps it when it passes 1023.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5078
name: load_sound_channel_from_entry
description: Reads a sound sequence entry, then sets the channel's sample pointer and length from a table of sound data. Effect code five adds to the volume and caps it at sixty-four, effect code six subtracts and floors at zero, and terminator codes stop the channel or update a global value.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:50E8
name: finish_sound_channel_setup
description: Sets the channel's start value and volume using the same effect rules as its sibling routine. It then either records a stop marker in a global or stores the sample pointer, length and sequence code in the channel record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5124
name: apply_sound_volume_and_store
description: Adds a volume offset from a register to a sound entry's level, caps the result at sixty-four and stores it. It then records a stop marker in a global or stores the sample fields in the channel record.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5156
name: store_sound_channel_record
description: When the sequence code of an entry is nonzero, stores the channel fields and marks the channel's bit in an active-channel word. A stop code instead sets the channel volume to zero.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5184
name: store_channel_sample_fields
description: Copies the sample pointer, length and sequence code from a sound entry into a channel record, then sets the channel's bit in an active-channel word.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5344
name: fill_buffers_with_mask_pattern
description: For each of four buffers, fills 8000 consecutive 32-bit words with either all ones or zero, chosen by one bit of a parameter.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5376
name: lock_df0_disk_directory
description: Releases any lock it holds through DOS, waits briefly, and then locks the DF0 drive through DOS, storing the lock handle. A fallback routine runs when the lock fails.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5472
name: wait_cia_port_bit_clear
description: Spins while a status bit of the CIA-A port register is set, then calls one routine.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:54B6
name: load_file_with_blitter_ownership
description: Calls a stored routine in a retry loop until it succeeds, reusing a cached handle when the requested sector matches. Around each file attempt it calls the DOS open, read, seek and close routines, and it takes and releases the blitter and multitasking control.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:55B0
name: forbid_and_own_blitter_checked
description: Disables multitasking and takes ownership of the blitter through the library bases, then returns minus one by default. It returns the result of one further routine only when a stack argument differs from the second parameter.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:55C0
name: write_background_color_with_delay
description: Writes the input word to the background colour register in a nested loop, which spaces out the writes with a fixed delay. It is called from six unnamed routines.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:55E2
name: blank_background_color_with_delay
description: Waits through a long delay loop, then writes zero to the background colour register 4096 times with a delay. It is called from seven unnamed routines.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:560C
name: initialise_buffers_and_libraries
description: Opens the DOS and graphics libraries and reads the free memory size. It then derives sixteen buffer addresses by stepping from a base address in increments of 8000 bytes, which is one bitplane of a 320 by 200 screen, and stores several pointer groups in globals.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:57E6
name: reset_dma_channel_bits
description: Clears one group of DMA enable bits in the DMA control register, then sets a different group, with calls to two routines before and after the writes.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5808
name: install_interrupt_server_node
description: Fills an interrupt server node with a priority of one hundred, a type code of two, a data pointer and a code pointer to a routine, then registers it through the exec library. It is called from one unnamed routine.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:585E
name: forbid_and_own_blitter
description: Disables multitasking through the exec library, then takes ownership of the blitter through the graphics library. It has no result.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:5874
name: release_blitter_and_permit
description: Releases the blitter through the graphics library, then re-enables multitasking through the exec library. It has no result.

key: another world (1991)(u. s. gold)[cr company][h prx](disk 1 of 2)/Another World (1991)(U. S. Gold)[cr Company][h PRX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:another:0:588A
name: start_copper_list
description: Loads the copper list address from a stored record into the copper pointer register, strobes the copper restart register, and writes the DMA control word that enables the copper.

name: or_pattern_store_table_entry
description: ORs a fixed bit pattern into a word at an indexed table entry, then stores a second word over that entry. The index comes from a register.

name: subtract_digit_offset_then_store
description: Subtracts the character code for zero from a byte at an indexed table entry, then stores a word over that entry.

name: set_three_bits_before_pointer
description: Sets one bit in each of three bytes just before a pointer, with each bit chosen by the low three bits of a register.

name: initialise_display_and_clear_memory
description: Disables multitasking, clears a long block of memory used for the display, and writes display setup values to the copper and display registers. It installs an interrupt handler, waits for a raster line, restores the system state and returns zero; the listed behaviour covers only these visible setup steps.

name: dispatch_interrupt_request_bits
description: Reads the interrupt request register and, when the master interrupt bit is set, calls one of three handlers from a table, chosen by which of three request bits is set.

name: dispatch_secondary_interrupt_bits
description: Calls the handler in one table slot when one request bit is set, and otherwise calls the handler in a second slot when another request bit is set.

name: dispatch_level_bit_handler
description: Calls the handler in one table slot when the request bit in a register is set, and otherwise returns with no result.

name: stub_return_only_routine_2
description: Contains only a return with no loads, stores or calls, so it does no work. Two unnamed routines reference it.

name: write_copper_list_pairs
description: Writes three register address and value pairs into a copper list area, with the last pair holding the wait end-marker values.

name: process_terminated_byte_list
description: Walks a list of two-byte records that ends with a minus-one marker, calling a routine for each record until the marker is reached.

name: copy_glyph_column_to_screen
description: Copies eight bytes from a glyph table entry, indexed by a character code offset by thirty-two, into a screen buffer. Each byte is written one screen row of eighty bytes after the last.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data_42
description: The decompiler reports bad instruction data and truncates control flow at once, so the 2044-instruction block has no readable behaviour. The entry was reached in the reference run.

name: setup_display_read_track
description: Disables DMA and interrupts, then in a retry loop calls a track read routine and copies a 32-word palette block into the colour registers. It sets the display control values and, when a value's bits are set, writes instruction words into memory before the loop breaks on success.

name: copy_sectors_into_buffer
description: Splits a linear byte offset into a track and a sector index using eleven sectors per track, then copies data from each 512-byte sector into the destination, moving to the next sector as each one is used up.

name: fill_buffer_with_gap_pattern
description: Fills a buffer of 416 longwords with a fixed alternating-bit gap pattern, unless its first longword already holds that pattern.

name: validate_sector_number_retry
description: Reads a byte and returns when it is below eleven, which is the valid sector range. Otherwise it marks a table word as invalid and retries, up to eleven attempts in all.

name: wait_for_sector_header_byte
description: Skips a fixed number of bytes, then reads up to ten values and returns early when one equals the expected sector header byte.

name: blit_mfm_decode_pass
description: Programs the blitter with source, mask and destination pointers and a size, computed from a sector offset, to run one bit-mask pass over a track buffer.

name: advance_sector_position_by_count
description: Steps a sector index forward by one for each count in a register, wrapping back to zero after the eleventh sector, and calls a routine on each step.

name: start_blitter_copy_pass
description: Computes three blitter pointer values from its input and an offset, programs the blitter control and size registers for a two-row copy, and then calls a routine.

name: decode_sector_header_and_check
description: Reads the sync words and header fields of a sector, checks them against the expected sector marker values and track number, and returns a numbered error code for each failed test. It returns zero when the header is valid.

name: set_or_clear_top_bit
description: Reads a byte at a pointer and a flag bit from the byte before it. When the flag is clear it sets the top bit of the target unless its second bit is already set, and when the flag is set it clears the top bit, then writes the byte back.

name: verify_sector_checksum
description: XOR-accumulates the masked long words of a sector block, compares the result with the stored checksum, and returns zero on a match or an error code otherwise.

name: decode_mfm_long_pair
description: Extracts the data bits from an odd and an even 32-bit word by masking each with an alternating-bit pattern, shifting one left by one, and combining the two results.

name: xor_checksum_table
description: Iterates over a table of 32-bit words, XOR-accumulating them into a running value. It then masks the result with an alternating-bit pattern and returns the final value.

name: shift_bits_across_long_pair
description: Shifts a 32-bit value and the word after it by the same count and combines the shifted parts into one 32-bit result, realigning bitstream data.

name: call_three_routines_in_sequence
description: Calls three unnamed routines in order and returns with no result. Two unnamed routines call it.

name: encode_mfm_long_word
description: Computes the clock bits of an MFM encoding for a 32-bit value from its data bits, clears the top clock bit when a flag byte before the destination is set, and stores the combined word through the pointer.

name: search_sync_word_table
description: Scans a buffer of 16-bit words for a sync marker, returns the matching table index when a word matches a table entry, and returns minus one when the buffer runs out.

name: copy_word_or_start_blitter
description: When a parameter is nonzero, copies a word from before the pointer. Otherwise it programs the blitter control, size and pointer registers for a decode pass and calls a routine.

name: start_blitter_decode_pass
description: Programs the blitter control, size and pointer registers for a decode pass, using a shifted parameter and a computed size, then calls a routine.

name: wait_disk_status_bit_clear
description: Spins while the bit with value sixty-four in the byte two places past a pointer is set, then returns.

name: initialise_disk_controller_fields
description: Writes a DMA control word and an alternating fill pattern into a disk control block, then clears three state fields.

name: start_disk_dma_read
description: When the zero flag is set, loads the disk buffer pointer, programs the disk control register for an MFM read, enables disk DMA and starts a read of a fixed length.

name: start_disk_dma_write
description: When a status bit is set, programs the disk control register for MFM write precompensation, enables disk DMA and starts a write of a fixed length.

name: wait_disk_transfer_done
description: Polls a disk status word for a fixed number of passes, clears the disk length register, and returns zero when the transfer has finished or minus one on timeout.

name: deselect_drive_bit
description: Clears one drive-select bit in the CIA-B port register, with the bit chosen from a stored drive index.

name: wait_drive_ready_status
description: Sets up a status register and waits for a disk status bit to clear within a fixed count, returning zero on success and an error code on timeout.

name: seek_drive_to_track
description: Compares the stored track position with the target track, steps the head once for each track of difference, records the new position and returns zero.

name: step_head_to_track_zero
description: Steps the head toward track zero until the track-zero sensor bit reports it, for up to a fixed number of steps, then records track zero and returns zero. It returns an error code when the sensor never reports.

name: set_step_direction_bit
description: Clears or keeps the direction bit of the CIA-B port register according to the sign of a parameter, sets the step bit, and calls a routine.

name: delay_after_drive_control_write
description: Writes a value to the CIA-B port through a routine, then spins through a fixed delay loop.

name: spin_short_delay
description: Decrements a register until it reaches zero, giving a short fixed delay.

name: build_drive_select_bits
description: Builds a CIA-B port value that selects a drive by clearing one bit chosen from a stored index, and clears a second bit when a stored flag is set. It then returns the value.

description: Writes a byte to the address before a pointer, then calls one of two handlers from a table depending on whether a count is zero.
